merry.name: Going Merry
merry.description: Permanently adds one team slot, immediately filled with a random character. One per player.

sunny.name: Thousand Sunny
sunny.description: Permanently adds one team slot, immediately filled with a random character. One per player.

nichirin.name: Nichirin Sword
nichirin.description: The equipped unit gains +15 Attack. Multiple copies stack.

whistle.name: White Whistle
whistle.description: Gives the strongest other ally +5% of every base stat. Uses base BST; ties go to the first ally. Multiple copies stack.

airgear.name: Air Gear
airgear.description: The equipped unit gains +15 Speed. Multiple copies stack.

finger.name: Sukuna’s Finger
finger.description: Replaces a chosen unit with Sukuna, with fresh UR stats totaling 600. Equipment and previous abilities are lost.

arrow.name: Stand Arrow
arrow.description: 70% chance to grant a new implemented passive; 30% chance to permanently kill the unit, leaving an empty slot. Maximum three passives per unit.

masterball.name: Master Ball
masterball.description: Replaces a chosen unit with a random UR character from your imported pool, with fresh stats. Requires an eligible UR character.
